summary: NX-ACCESS backend + frontend end-to-end test. 28/28 backend pytest cases passed covering auth (admin/viewer login, /auth/me, refresh, bad creds), structure (sites/areas/doors), people (list/create/get/delete/CSV export), devices (list, test, sync), events/alarms, remote door open, dashboard/stats, reports (access/occupancy/presence), admin (users/audit/settings), emergency muster, and RBAC (viewer blocked from create and users list). Frontend validated: admin login succeeds and redirects from /login to '/'; token stored in localStorage key nx_access_token; dashboard renders all 6 KPI cards (kpi-granted/denied/devices/alarms/doors/people) + hourly area chart + recent events; topbar shows 'TEMPO REAL CONECTADO'; Live Monitoring feed streams via WebSocket (30 -> 32 events in 12s); remote-door-unlock-button opens a select with 6 doors, selecting one enables confirm-door-unlock-button which successfully opens door and shows success toast 'Porta aberta remotamente'; People page loads with search/add/export; Devices page shows 4 simulated devices with test/sync buttons working; Estrutura, Alarmes, Emergência (panic+restore testids present), Relatórios (3 tabs), Administração (3 tabs with user list) all accessible; RBAC: viewer login hides 'Administração' nav item (count 0) and 'person-add-button' (count 0).
critical_code_review_comments: WebSocket URL exposes JWT access_token in query string (standard pattern but logs/proxies may capture it). Consider short-lived WS-only token.
Login response returns tokens in body AND sets cookies — expected trade-off documented by main agent for preview env; ensure production uses httpOnly+Secure cookies only.
Backend endpoints use plural prefixes except structure which groups under /structure/{sites|areas|doors} — slight inconsistency with top-level /people, /devices (not a bug, just naming).
test_credentials: Admin felipejferreira@gmail.com / NxAccess@2026, Viewer leitura@nxaccess.com / Leitura@2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). All verified working.
seed_data_creation: Seed is idempotent and auto-ran: 1 site, 3 areas, 6 doors, 4 simulated devices, 50 people, 7 days of events + background simulator broadcasting every 4-9s via WS. Verified via KPIs (497 total events, 50 people, 4/4 devices online, 6 doors).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All playbook features verified. backend_test file is /app/backend/tests/test_nx_access.py (pytest + requests). Live-event-feed-table is a <div> container (not <table>), so count child elements via el.children.length. remote-door-unlock-button is a Select trigger — must open and pick a door option before confirm-door-unlock-button becomes clickable. Nav labels sometimes get intercepted by overlays; prefer direct URL navigation (/monitoramento, /pessoas, /dispositivos, /estrutura, /alarmes, /emergencia, /relatorios, /administracao).
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. All playbook functional requirements pass.
